quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report (08-14-2026), product and R&D pipeline (DS): HBM4 - world-first mass-production shipment (02-2026) of the industry's highest-performance HBM4 built on the most advanced 1c DRAM (10nm-class 6th generation) with a 4nm base die, running at 11.7 Gbps (up to 13 Gbps) against the 8 Gbps JEDEC standard, offered in 24GB (8-high) to 48GB (16-high) capacities, positioned as a logic-memory-foundry-packaging 'one-stop solution' with pre-emptive infrastructure investment for supply stability. HBM4E - industry-first 12-high HBM4E samples shipped 05-2026 at 14 Gbps per pin (up to 16 Gbps), 3.6 TB/s per stack (20%+ above HBM4), 16% better energy efficiency and 14% better thermal resistance than HBM4. Server DRAM: 1c (10nm-class 6th gen) DRAM in mass production since 06-2025 with 30%+ productivity and ~10% power gains, HBM included in the 1c line-up; SOCAMM2 LPDDR server module developed 12-2025 (2x RDIMM bandwidth, 55%+ lower power). Storage: PCIe 6.0 server SSD PM1763 developed (9th-gen V-NAND plus 4nm controller, 16TB, optimised for direct-to-chip liquid cooling); industry-first on-device-AI UFS 5.0 developed 06-2026 (10.8 GB/s, 2x UFS 4.1, 40% better power efficiency, up to 1TB); 24Gb GDDR7 in mass production since 01-2025 (42.5 Gbps, 1.92 TB/s). System LSI: Exynos Modem 5410, Exynos 1680, Exynos Connect 6375 launched; a new Custom SoC opportunity is being pursued for Agentic AI; the Power business is diversifying from mobile into SERVER power ICs; image sensors expanding into automotive. DX: Galaxy S26 series (03-2026), Galaxy Book6 (Intel Panther Lake, NVIDIA RTX 5060/5070 options), Micro RGB and Neo Mini LED TV lines; TV value share 30.6%, smartphone unit share 22.0% in H1 2026.
